reviewer: Kimi independent actual visual third-round review of external-03 against the exact native source, enlarged source page 13 and targeted source panel, complete unchanged full native RGBA raw, targeted native-resolution note/right-edge crop, full white/cyan/alpha sheet and unchanged naiwa mascot reference; earlier review files were left unchanged

remaining_reasons: The source has a small dark tab on the middle of the note's right edge. External-03 instead retains a much larger dark rectangular tab at the note's upper-right corner. Restore the original small right-edge tab at its source position and scale, rather than an oversized upper-right tab or folded-corner treatment.
entries.positive_observation: External-03 restores the source viewer-right three-quarter head pose and rightward gaze. The cap crown and glossy visor remain inside the original dark frame silhouette, with no cap/frame crossing or changed frame outline. The note has only two upper gray-mark rows and no additional lower-left horizontal dash, with largely blank lower paper. The dark olive cap retains two gold front insignia elements and gold braid/piping. Dark brows remain, with covered hair and no glasses, moustache or beard. The dark olive tunic retains the red standing collar and gold-embroidered red tabs without a visible tie. The rounded lower head meets a short broad collar. The opaque dark olive-charcoal backplate remains, and full white/cyan comparisons show no visible holes, lost backing or working-matte ring. The oversized relocated right-edge tab is the remaining rejection reason.
entries.visible_limitations: Fine motifs inside the cap/collar insignia and note glyphs are unreadable at source scale. No additional rejection is based on those tiny details; the source's small mid-right tab versus the returned large upper-right rectangular tab is directly visible.
